entry.summary: Every developer who has ever needed to share code in a slide deck, a blog post, or a GitHub issue has reached for the same two tools: a screenshot, or a manual copy into a presentation tool. Screenshots are blurry and fixed-size. Manual copies lose syntax highlighting and formatting. And the popular web tools that render code to images? CodeFrame is a web app that converts source code into high-resolution PNG (or SVG) images, in the style of carbon.now.sh and ray.so, but with one hard architectural difference: it never screenshots the DOM.
